subject: Enquiry: Example Digital Skills Innovation Grant
preheader: A short enquiry from Tech2Grassroots Africa about your digital skills grant.
body_paragraphs_html:
We are an education technology and digital skills organisation based in Nigeria, and we would like to confirm that organisations like ours are eligible to apply.

Could you please let us know whether there is an eligibility guide or a recommended point of contact for applicants?
key_points_html:
• Focus areas: digital skills, AI education and youth empowerment
  • Partnered with 15 schools and trained over 5,000 learners
  • Operates the Kwara Innovation Lab (KIL)
